svg.text: Take B: Ring main (bore 0.24, ring main 0.20; T03i 0.44)

B Ring main: a slim ring main bolted round the press's foot (axis r 1.50, bore 0.20; through the north guide feet, which carry it as cast tees) is where the fluid goes, all round the head; each connection is a short

spur to it: a steel flange on the plate over the fitting, a flanged elbow up, along the same lanes as A, into a flanged tee on the ring (the big drill's elbow boxes and clamped runs; the foundry's base ring).

Runs (plan; N/S keyed by the fitting's side of x, E/W by north/south of centre): E+: 0.92 long, turns 15 deg, over bay 0.23 for 0.88; E-: 1.34 long, turns 0 deg; N+: 1.02 long, turns 14 deg, over bay 0.05 for 0.78; N-: 1.02 long, turns 14 deg, over bay 0.05 for 0.78;
S+: 1.02 long, turns 14 deg, over bay 0.05 for 0.78; S-: 1.02 long, turns 14 deg, over bay 0.05 for 0.78; W+: 0.92 long, turns 15 deg, over bay 0.23 for 0.88; W-: 1.34 long, turns 0 deg.
Clearance, bore edge in plan, worst over all 8 fittings: bastions 0.01, guide feet 0.09; off the plate 0; never turns back (the distance still to go falls all the way, every run).
